In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''runcinated tesseractic honeycomb''' is a uniform  space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) in Euclidean 4-space. It is constructed by a [[Runcination (geometry)|runcination]] of a [[tesseractic honeycomb]] creating [[runcinated tesseract]]s, and new [[tesseract]], [[rectified tesseract]] and [[cuboctahedral prism]] facets.
